title: A Horizon for the Wreck
author: Beatrix Voss
blurb: Sable Villalobos, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, has spent fifteen years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
